In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement: The number of cybercrime incidents reported in Country Z has doubled over the last two years, primarily due to inadequate cybersecurity measures in place.Courses of Action:I. The government should launch a public awareness campaign on cybersecurity practices.II. Stringent regulations and penalties for cybercrimes should be implemented and enforced immediately.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Both I and II follow.) है।

questions.question: In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13, can be performed. In a certain code language, ‘A z B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,  ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’ and‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.How is P related to H if ‘P z I # T + C × H’?1751

Mr. E starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the East. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 22 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 19 km. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (7 km to the North) है।
